name: Choosing to Speak — SimplePractice2 Context Sync

nodes.name: Get Calendar Events
nodes.notes: Use the existing n8nitro Google Calendar credential for the SimplePractice2 calendar. No secrets are stored in this workflow export.

nodes.name: Parse Events & Fetch Notion Notes
nodes.notes: Uses NOTION_API_KEY_PLANNER, NOTION_API_KEY, or NOTION_TOKEN from n8nitro env. Keep this duplicate secret-free.

nodes.name: OpenRouter - Generate Content
nodes.notes: Use the existing n8nitro Header Auth credential named OpenRouter API. No API key is stored in this workflow export.

nodes.name: Send to Choosing to Speak Brain
nodes.notes: Posts normalized roster and prep directly to Choosing to Speak. Configure CTS_BETA_TOKEN in n8nitro env.

nodes.name: Build Choosing to Speak Payload
nodes.notes: Normalizes the existing planner payload into the Choosing to Speak /v1/day_roster contract.

main.node: Send to Choosing to Speak Brain
